general_background.title: Arsenic supply sets the growth surface environment
general_background.summary: The group-V to group-III supply ratio helps determine how arsenic-rich the surface remains during indium arsenide growth. Changing arsenic pressure at a fixed indium supply can alter surface incorporation and the way strained islands grow.
general_background.label: General background, not the authors' interpretation

general_background.title: Strain and growth interruptions affect epitaxial islands
general_background.summary: In strain-driven indium arsenide epitaxy, a wetting layer can give way to islands as the growing film relieves lattice strain. During a growth interruption the surface can continue to reorganize, so the island population need not remain fixed when the incoming flux changes.
